text: Si on noddii sanamuuji mon ɗin onon ɓee sirkooɓe faade e peewal, ɗi nanataa noddaandu mon. A yi'ay ɗi hiɗi fewtini gite majji feeraaɗe e maaɗa, koɗi joordi diyi'ataa. Ɓen sirkooɓe moƴƴinanyno sanamuuji nanndina e neɗɗo maa kulle, ɓe waɗanaɗi juɗe e koyɗe e gite, kono hara ɗi alaa wonkii ko ɗi memminora.
